omissions.reason: The doubtful y/v underletter overwritten by a secure y within conoyau is a French spelling-layer change. Cokernel has no corresponding English change; the source-letter uncertainty is retained in translator note 25-150-1.
The canceled t after French les is a letter-level typing cancellation with no English effect in the images; recorded in translator note 25-151-1.

variant_notes.note: Canceled augmenté is translated as augmented before ring, following English adjective placement.
The secure canceled word singularité is translated as singularity; its following incomplete qu is retained literally and explained in translator note 25-151-1.
